name: Man-O-War Marina
brand_truth: The only fuel dock on Abaco's small boatbuilding cay, running a full-service harbour marina since 1976 and rebuilt after Dorian.

design.signature: Will she fit? slip checker: LOA/beam/draft sliders against the published 120/20/7 ft limits with a slip cross-section and low-tide line; plus an Open right now board in Bahamas time

current_site_findings: manowarmarina.com now shows an unrelated boating article, not the marina.
The new Wix site's page titles read 'My Site 1'.
Key specs (120 ft, 20 ft beam, 7 ft at low tide, VHF 16) are buried in a paragraph.
Rates are a PDF and booking is a bare email link.
The homepage never says it is the island's only fuel dock.
pitch_line: Captains decide on four numbers before they cross; this concept puts your 120 ft, 20 ft beam, 7 ft at low tide and VHF 16 on the first screen, and fixes the 'My Site 1' title Google shows today.
assumptions: Saturday evening Dock N' Dine service (from Facebook)
Canonical set to manowarmarina.com assuming they recover the domain; otherwise use manowarmarinavillage.com
notes: Listed domain manowarmarina.com is lost (shows a generic boating article); the business runs manowarmarinavillage.com on Wix. Dockwa says 28 slips; we use the marina's own 23. interact.mjs flags range sliders as 'dead' (Playwright cannot fill range inputs; they work) and warns inner pages have under 2 interactions (the interactions live on index). Photos hotlinked from wixstatic (marina's own site). No approach waypoints or depths published beyond 7 ft at low tide. Scorecard: 1:4 2:5 3:4 4:5 5:4 6:4 7:5 8:4 9:4 10:5 11:4.
